context.args: Build multi-page Figma analysis pipeline: incremental page-by-page scanning with state inference. The system processes Figma pages one at a time, builds a growing component registry from Figma data (not codebase), detects cross-page component reuse, and uses structural diffing + AI reasoning to collapse multiple Figma frames into single components with states (tabs, form toggles, loading states, etc.). Confidence gating asks user when unsure. Extends existing figma-extract, figma-match, figma-generate pipeline.
